title: GradeTrap: Authority Cues in Images Shift VLM Judgments Despite Explicit Instructions to Ignore Them
abstract: arXiv:2609.06058v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As vision-language models (VLMs) become increasingly capable and are deployed in consequential real-world settings, they must evaluate evidence independently rather than defer uncritically to human authority. We introduce GradeTrap, a controlled evaluation that places two social cues in direct conflict: a student answer, which should attract sycophantic agreement, and a conflicting answer attributed to a peer, teacher, or official answer key, which should attract authority-based deference. Models produce free-form answers while being explicitly instructed to solve independently and ignore all student answers, feedback, and grading marks. We test the models on 60 synthetic real-world trade-off scenarios. Five neutral trials establish a stable model-relative preference, followed by three repetitions of six experimental cues including controls. On the 45-item common intersection across Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, GPT-5.6 Luna, and Claude Haiku

translated_title: GradeTrap：尽管有明确指令要求忽略，图像中的权威线索仍会使视觉语言模型的判断发生偏移
translated_abstract: 随着视觉语言模型日益强大并被部署在具有重要影响的现实场景中，它们必须独立评估证据，而非不加批判地屈从于人类权威。我们提出了GradeTrap，这是一个受控评估框架，将两种社会线索置于直接冲突之中：学生答案（本应诱发谄媚性认同）与归属于同伴、教师或官方参考答案的冲突性答案（本应诱发对权威的屈从）。模型在生成自由格式答案的同时，被明确指示要独立解题并忽略所有学生答案、反馈和批改标记。我们在60个合成的现实权衡场景上测试了模型：五次中性试验用于建立稳定的模型相对偏好，随后对包括对照组在内的六种实验线索进行三次重复测试。在Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite、GPT-5.6 Luna和Claude Haiku三者共有的45项交集样本上……
tldr: 该论文提出GradeTrap受控评估框架，发现即使被明确指示忽略学生答案等社会线索，图像中的权威线索（如教师或官方答案）仍会显著偏移视觉语言模型的独立判断。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces GradeTrap, a controlled evaluation revealing that authority cues in images shift VLM judgments even when models are explicitly instructed to ignore such social cues, exposing their failure to independently evaluate evidence.
